  /packages/spec/pages/foundations/dimension/primitive.html         dimension tokens · historical primitive page (px scale retired)
  /packages/spec/pages/foundations/dimension/spacing.html           dimension tokens · semantic spacing (T-shirt scale)
  /packages/spec/pages/foundations/dimension/sizing.html            dimension tokens · semantic sizing (T-shirt scale)
  /packages/spec/pages/foundations/dimension/radius.html            dimension tokens · semantic radius (T-shirt scale + 9999px sentinel full)
  /packages/spec/pages/foundations/iconography.html                 <nuri-icon> · glyph registry GENERATED from icons/*.svg · one drawing per glyph · 2 sizes (md 24 · sm 18) · currentColor
  Theming:
  /packages/spec/pages/components/scope.html          <nuri-scope> · Tier 3 theming primitive · web↔RN scope spec · START HERE for migration
  /packages/spec/pages/components/palette.html        colour namespace · class-layer dispatch (variant/chrome) · merged-node authoring · owns ALL colour (65.3 §6)
  Actions:

  Layout:
  /packages/spec/pages/components/stack.html          flex stack layout primitive

  Navigation:

Build assets (dist · fetchable · 6 kinds · all emitted by `npm run build`):
  /packages/spec/build/tokens.json                 DTCG primitives (W3C standard · 216 colour tokens)
  /packages/spec/build/tokens.ts                   RN-ready · runtime sets · chrome + accent + space + size + radius + ratio (41 leaves) + border hairline + type scale
  /packages/spec/build/interaction.ts              transversal interaction baseline · { pressScale · disabledOpacity } · the dec-45 cross-component constants (read from --nuri-interaction-* · Smell-1 · dec 66)
  /packages/spec/build/token-paths.ts              discriminated union of every runtime-set leaf (41 members)
  /packages/spec/build/icons.ts                    typed glyph registry · IconName union + icons[name] SVG markup · GENERATED from icons/*.svg (one drawing per glyph · currentColor · no weights)
  /packages/spec/build/descriptors/<name>.ts       per-component DESCRIPTOR · the frozen R-EXPO-6 contract (theme thunk · variants / compoundVariants · part-addressable $parts) · schema.ts + 3: composition-button · icon-avatar · topbar (N+19 · decision 65.2)

Repository entry points:
  /README.md                         project overview
  /AGENTS.md                         skill router (for spec-authoring)
  /roadmap/index.md                  sessions + current state
  /decisionlog.md                    locked decisions
  /skills/                           per-skill procedures (kebab-case files)
  /prompts/                          reusable agent prompt templates
  /docs/RISKS.md                     open risks with named failure modes

Source of truth: this repo's `packages/spec/styles/` CSS files. HTML pages
and build assets are derived; never edit them directly. (Descriptors derive
from two sources — the component `@layer` CSS under `packages/spec/lib/components/`
for the mapping half + the page `data-part` anatomy under
`packages/spec/pages/components/` for the structure half · decision 65 / 24.1.)
